channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: When The North Face Does Denim, It's Indestructible
item.description: The North Face’s jeans are nothing like your everyday jeans. This is near-indestructible denim made with CORDURA.

item.title: Nike's Boldest, Bluest Dad Shoe Is a Swooshless All-Leather Stunner
item.description: Nike's all-leather, Swooshless Zoom Vomero 5 sneaker is back in a new extra-bold "Hyper Royal" colorway. Here's everything on the latest release.

item.title: Only Real Skaters Ride VERDY's Real Skateboards
item.description: VERDY’s created three limited-edition Real Skateboard boards for Skate Shop Day. But there aren’t many to go around.

item.title: Nike’s Waviest Sneaker Has Never Looked Haute-r
item.description: Nike's Astra Ultra "Black Lace" sneaker is an elegant, couture-coded take on the futuristic 3D AI-designed sneaker.

item.title: Nike's Impressively Fresh Jordans Went From Black Cat to Lucky Cat
item.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Lucky Cat" sneakers feature luxe details inspired by the beckoning cat, which is known to bring good luck & fortune.

item.title: Tremaine Emory Wants Denim Tears to Teach You What History Books Won't
item.description: Denim Tears' Spring/Summer 2026 collection is a prime example of Tremaine Emory's vision for his label, the creative director explains in interview.

item.title: adidas’ Best Ballet Sneaker Is Officially the Prettiest of Them All
item.description: adidas' Taekwondo Mei Elite appears in a tonal "Sandy Pink" colorway, complete with silky finishes for a true ballet sneaker feel.

item.title: Nike's Caramel-Flavored High-Tech Air Max Is a Tasty Sweet Treat
item.description: The delicious, caramel-colored Air Max 95 Light British Tan drops alongside a Cargo Khaki version which continues the earthy palette, ideal year-round.

item.title: New Balance’s American-Made Dad Shoe Is Like a Creamy Matcha Latte
item.description: New Balance's Made in U.S.A. 990v4 "Olive Leaf" sneaker kicks off the SS26 season with its delicious matcha latte-minded design.

item.title: adidas' Washed Denim Running Shoe Is Literally Out of This World
item.description: adidas' Galaxy OG sneaker is a denim-dusted stunner that is quite literally out of this world.
